frontmatter.title: Stop Charging for AI Calls: Outcome-Based Pricing for AI Engineering Teams
frontmatter.subheading: Designing AI systems where value is measured in success, not token usage
frontmatter.excerpt: Outcome-based pricing is reshaping how AI applications are monetized. This article breaks down the trade-offs between per-request and per-success pricing, with practical guidance for AI engineers building value-driven systems.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
